paragraphs.notes: Whole page body is a single un-numbered continuation of the Markush substituent enumeration inside the Patentansprueche. The claims begin on printed page 79 (PDF p81) with 'Patentansprueche:' and claim 1; no new claim number and no new symbol heading starts on this page, so the symbol this list belongs to is fixed on an earlier page. WO A1 publications carry no [00NN] paragraph markers, so marker is null. The page starts mid-enumeration (the first item continues the list begun on printed page 82, PDF p84, whose last item is 'Cycloalkylalkenyloxycarbonyl,') and ends mid-term on 'Cycloalkyl-', continuing onto printed page 84 (PDF p86). LINE-BREAK REJOINING: six printed lines break immediately after 'N-Alkyl-N-' and have been rejoined with no space inserted, because the same term appears unbroken elsewhere in the patent: 'N-Alkyl-N-' + 'arylaminocarbonyl', + 'heteroarylaminocarbonyl', + 'arylaminocarbonyloxy', + 'heteroarylaminocarbonyloxy', + 'arylaminocarbonyl-amino', + 'heteroarylaminocarbonylamino'. Line breaks after 'Mono-' are NOT rejoins: the printed text is 'Mono- oder', and the space is kept. No other change was made to the printed text. FOUR IRREGULARITIES READ AS PRINTED AND DELIBERATELY NOT CORRECTED. (1) 'Heterocyclylalkcarbonyloxy' is printed with 'alk' and no 'yl', between 'Heterocyclylcarbonyloxy' and 'Heterocyclylalkenylcarbonyloxy'. Verified at 4x: the glyphs read a-l-k-c. Its position suggests the intended term is Heterocyclylalkylcarbonyloxy, but the characters are absent from the page and have not been supplied. (2) The carbonyloxy sub-series of the aminocarbonyl block starts abruptly at 'Mono- oder Diheteroarylaminocarbonyloxy': the parallel 'Dialkylaminocarbonyloxy' and 'Diarylaminocarbonyloxy' members that the neighbouring blocks all carry are not printed. Verified at 3x that the preceding line ends 'gegebenenfalls substituiertes Mono- oder' and the next begins 'Diheteroarylaminocarbonyloxy,'. Nothing has been inserted. (3) The cycloalkylcarbonyloxy sub-series runs 'Cycloalkylcarbonyloxy, Cycloalkylalkenylcarbonyloxy, Cycloalkylalkinylcarbonyloxy' with no 'Cycloalkylalkylcarbonyloxy' between the first two, although the parallel cycloalkenyl series two items later does carry its alkyl member. Verified at 3x. (4) Hyphenation of the N-substituted amino terms varies as printed within one series: 'N-Alkyl-N-arylaminocarbonyl-amino' carries a hyphen before the final 'amino' where its two neighbours do not, and 'Alkylcarbonyl-N-arylamino' and 'Alkylcarbonyl-N-heteroarylamino' are printed without the '-alkyl-'-style hyphen that 'Arylcarbonyl-N-alkyl-amino' and 'Heteroarylcarbonyl-N-alkyl-amino' carry. Transcribed exactly as printed. The en field is a translation, not a copy: these are GERMAN group names, and German 'Alkinyl' is English 'alkynyl' throughout; 'gegebenenfalls substituiertes' is 'optionally substituted'. German noun capitalisation is dropped in en. The four irregularities above are carried through into en unchanged, including the untouched 'heterocyclylalkcarbonyloxy'. A small stray ink speckle sits above the line beginning 'Heteroaryloxycarbonyl', roughly above the 'y' of 'Heteroarylalkenyloxycarbonyl'; the same mark appears at the same place on the neighbouring pages, so it is scanner dirt, not a printed character.
